cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Name What It Cost
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the emotional cost of what happened, not merely the event itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me what six weeks without an answer did to me. Not what happened to the phone; what happened to me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the equipment failure. I didn't know about it. Please answer the question about the person waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. And every morning I rewrote my message to make it easier to answer. Include that, please: I thought I was the difficult part.
